Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on addressing project progress, integration challenges, and resource management.
Krishna Sindhur, Yash Mori, Praneetaa Lakshmi, and others participated, discussing front-end and back-end issues.
Key issues included API changes, resource allocation, hosting costs, and client communication.
Follow-up actions involve tracking extra work, improving client communication, and evaluating hosting solutions.
Decisions were made to document changes, enhance communication, and explore cost-effective hosting options.

Resource Allocation and Management
Address integration challenges, improve team synchronization. Enhance communication between teams, create clear integration plans to address challenges.
Ensuring optimal resource allocation, management for project efficiency, addressing integration challenges.
Resource allocation issues affecting project timelines, efficiency. Limited resources prevent timely completion of tasks, leading to missed deadlines.
Decisions: Optimize resource allocation, align team efforts with project goals. Reallocate resources to critical tasks, ensure teams aligned with project objectives.
Integration challenges between front-end and back-end tasks. Difficulties in synchronizing tasks between front-end and back-end teams causing inefficiencies.
Ongoing Project Progress
Integration challenges, resource allocation issues affecting team efficiency. Team struggling with limited resources, difficulty aligning front-end and back-end tasks.
Shuffled client priorities, added requirements impacting project timeline. Client keeps adding new API parameters, changing priorities, leading to significant delays.
The team is addressing ongoing project tasks, with API and front-end integration progress. Key focus is on completing tasks by October 10 deadline, ensuring minimal disruptions.
Decisions: Document extra work, changes for client billing, transparency. Team agreed to track extra efforts to justify billing and inform client about scope changes.
Team alignment to optimize resource allocation, meet deadlines. Internal communication improved to ensure efficient resource use, alignment with project goals.
API and Front-End Integration
UI subtasks, API synchronization challenges. Difficulty ensuring UI subtasks align correctly with API changes, causing inconsistencies.
Completing front-end integration, API tasks with focus on addressing API changes, subtask issues. Ensures seamless integration between APIs and front-end for user experience.
Frequent API changes causing disruptions, delays. Addition of new API parameters periodically requires reworking existing logic, delaying overall progress.
Decisions: Track API changes, document extra work for transparency. Record all extra efforts, changes for future reference, client communication.
Push code updates post-completion, provide demos for client feedback. Ensure all tasks are completed, reviewed internally before client demos to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments.
Client Expectations and Communication
Decisions: Improve client satisfaction through better communication, documentation. Plan to maintain detailed records of changes, communicate proactively with client to align expectations.
Propose blocking extra requirements, scheduling them for subsequent cycles. Suggestion to handle additional requirements in future cycles to maintain current deadlines.
Disruptions due to evolving client requirements, resource allocation issues. Frequent changes in client requirements cause delays, resource mismanagement.
Misalignment between client expectations and project deliverables. Client's expectations often exceed initially agreed scope, causing dissatisfaction.
Emphasizing clear client communication manage expectations regarding deliverables, timelines. Aim is enhance client satisfaction while reducing miscommunications.
Task Management and Collaboration
Resource allocation issues impacting project timelines. Limited resources lead to delays in task completion, affecting overall project timeline.
Plan task distributions, manage resources for better efficiency. Assign tasks based on current resource availability, prioritize critical tasks to improve workflow.
Lack of synchronization between front-end, back-end teams. Tasks not aligned, causing bottlenecks, inefficiencies.
Decisions: Document tasks, changes for client communication, billing. Keep detailed records of tasks, changes to facilitate better communication with the client, accurate billing.
Aligning front-end and back-end tasks for efficient collaboration, clear task distribution. Ensure both teams work in sync for smooth project execution.
Cost Management and Hosting Solutions
Explore cost-effective alternatives, monitor hosting expenses. Evaluate different hosting platforms, compare costs, and monitor expenses to stay within budget.
Evaluating hosting solutions, managing costs for project stability, considering options like Kubernetes, third-party hosting.
High hosting costs, resource management challenges. Costs associated with current hosting solutions high, leading to budget concerns.
Maintenance, management issues with self-hosting. Self-hosting adds complexity, requires additional resources for maintenance.
Decisions: Consider Kubernetes, third-party hosting for cost-effectiveness. Explore using Kubernetes, or third-party hosting providers like Vercel to reduce costs, streamline operations.
